profile.title: Profile
profile.familyHint: Book appointments for people in your household.

form.name: Full name
form.abhaHint: 14 digits, for example 91-2345-6789-0123. It keeps your health records in one place.
form.conditionsHint: For example: diabetes, high blood pressure. Separate with commas.

register.title: Create your profile
register.subtitle: We need a few details before you book.

consent.title: Your consent
consent.intro: Before we save your details, please read how we use them.

points.collect: We collect your name, age, gender, mobile number, address, optional ABHA number, and the symptoms you share with the assistant.
points.purpose: We use them only to book and manage your hospital visits, guide you to the right department, and share your reported symptoms with your doctor.
points.share: Your details are shared only with hospital staff involved in your care. We never sell your data.
points.retention: We keep your records for as long as needed for your care and as required by law.
points.rights: You can view and correct your details in your profile, withdraw your consent, or ask us to delete your data by contacting the hospital.

consent.law: This consent is requested under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
consent.dataProcessing: I agree to MediFlow storing and using my details as described above.
consent.notifications: Send me appointment and queue updates by SMS and WhatsApp (optional).

settings.title: Settings
settings.travelHint: We use this to tell you when to leave home.

records.title: Health records
records.subtitle: Upload old prescriptions, lab reports and discharge summaries. Your doctor sees a short summary before your visit.
records.paused: Reading documents is switched off right now
records.pausedBody: Please bring your old reports with you to the visit.
records.saved: Document saved and shared with your doctor

upload.title: Add a document
upload.hint: Photos (JPG, PNG) or PDF. You can choose more than one. The preview stays on this device.
upload.samples: No document at hand? Try a sample

review.title: Check what we read
review.body: Correct anything that is wrong before saving. Fields marked "Please check" were hard to read.
review.aiLabel: Read by the medical records assistant from your document. It may make mistakes.
review.discardBody: What we read from it will not be saved.

list.title: Your documents
list.sharedNote: Your doctor sees these in your pre-visit summary.
list.emptyBody: Upload a prescription or lab report to share it with your doctor.
list.deleteBody: Your doctor will no longer see it.

how.title: How it works
how.upload: Take a photo of a prescription or report, or choose files.
how.read: The assistant reads the medicines, test values and dates.
how.check: You check it and correct anything that is wrong.
how.share: Your doctor sees a short summary before your visit.

care.title: Care plans
care.subtitle: Your medicines, your doctor's advice and follow-up, after each visit.
care.paused: The care companion is switched off right now
care.pausedBody: Your doctor's note is in your appointment details. Call the hospital with any questions.
care.emptyBody: After your doctor signs your prescription, your care plan appears here.

checkIn.title: Follow-up check-ins
checkIn.body: The companion asks how you are on day 3 and day 7. For a demo, you can send the day 3 check-in now.

chat.title: Ask about your care plan
chat.scope: Answers come only from {{doctor}}'s prescription and advice. Anything else goes to your doctor.
